description:
The Government intends to make a sole-source award to McKenna Engineering &

Equipment Co, Inc. (McKenna) for a 3196 STI SIZE: 1X1.5-8/5V pump.   Goulds’s 3196 STI SIZE: 1X1.5-8/5V pumps are installed and utilized for the sewage discharge system in the Military Sealift Command’s T-AO Class of ships.  McKenna is the OEM-authorized parts provider for Goulds pumps in the state of California.  

This notice of intent is not a request for quotes. A determination not to compete the proposed procurement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.
